name: Where the Bears Are
description: A comedy mystery web-series that follows the exploits of three gay bear roommates living together in Los Angeles, as they attempt to solve the murder of a party guest that turned up dead in their bathtub.

videos.title: Where The Bears: Are Season 1
videos.overview: The bears are caught up in a murder investigation when they find a man dead in their bathtub the morning after Nelson's birthday party.

videos.title: Interview Ben Zook, Joe Dietl, Rick Copp
videos.overview: Interview Ben Zook, Joe Dietl, Rick Copp

videos.title: Bear Trap (2)
videos.overview: Reggie and Wood arrive at the Palm Springs condo to rescue Nelson, but their friend is nowhere to be found because he is about to become the killer's next victim during a frightening desert showdown.

videos.title: Where The Bears Are: Season 2
videos.overview: The bears are again caught in a murder investigation when Elliot Butler, Reggie's former college roommate and a candidate for city council, turns up dead at his campaign launch party.

videos.title: Where The Bears Are: Season 3
videos.overview: Reggie is producing a reality television pilot for a true crime series, and the bears consequently try to solve a string of murders involving models for Chunk Studios, a bear porn studio.

videos.title: Where The Bears Are: Season 4
videos.overview: The fourth season starts with the shooting of Todd at his wedding to Nelson, and then flashes back to tell the story leading to the event.

videos.title: Where The Bears Are: Season 5
videos.overview: Season 5 breaks from the murder mystery aspects to switch to a spy narrative, focusing this time on Todd Stevens as a newly minted spy for his security agency, setting the bears off on a madcap race to keep a dangerous computer virus from ending up in the wrong hands and sniff out a mole from the agency.

videos.title: Wrestling Bears
videos.overview: Todd coerces Wood into posing as a Lucha Libre wrestler in order to get close to a friend of Chase's, a professional wrestler named Crusher, who is known for his killer bear hugs. But despite Todd's assurances that Wood will never have to get in the ring, Nelson's overzealous performance as a wrestling coach proves otherwise.

videos.title: Mariachi Bears
videos.overview: The Bears converge on a Mexican restaurant with Nelson, Reggie and Wood posing as members of a mariachi band and Todd as a waiter in order to set a trap for Chase. But unfortunately when Reggie and Wood allow their personal dramas take center stage, the carefully orchestrated plan blows up in their faces.

videos.title: Bears Across the Border, Part One
videos.overview: After Todd is nearly drowned following an aborted assassination attempt and the killer escapes, the Bears enlist the aid of Winters and Martinez in order to find Chase Hansen before it's too late. Meanwhile, Bjorn reports back to Victor Garcia to face his wrath after failing in his mission to take out Todd.

videos.title: Bears Across the Border, Part Two
videos.overview: Unbeknownst to the Bears, Todd launches a sting operation in a Mexico City park known for its gay cruising in order to finally snare Chase Hansen and retrieve the thumb drive, but things don't go exactly according to plan when Reggie and Wood, trying to forget the pain of Chase's betrayal, both hook up with the wrong tricks.

videos.title: Bears Across the Border, Part Three
videos.overview: In the rip-roaring, hair-raising season finale, Nelson, Todd, Winters and Martinez form the Wild Bear Bunch and descend upon a remote Mexican village right out of a spaghetti western film in order to rescue Reggie and Wood from Victor Garcia's clutches, but the menacing crime lord has no intention of allowing any of them to leave the country alive once he has the thumb drive in his possession.

videos.title: Where The Bears Are: Season 6
videos.overview: Season 6 sees another madcap romp, with Nelson on trial for murder.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Reggie (Rick Copp) tapes an episode of his TV show in the mountains of Big Bear in order to recount the dramatic events from four years ago when Jeremy Richards (Mark Rowe) tried pushing him off a cliff to his death. Meanwhile, Prince Omar (Chris Yonan) reveals his true motive for buying the Inquisitive Channel and a sexy Murder Time crew member (Joe Carrier) offers the perfect solution for Wood and George when their actors are a no show for their porn shoot.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: A surprise guest hijacks the Murder Time taping in Big Bear exposing Reggie (Rick Copp) as a liar to all his loyal viewers. Meanwhile, Todd has finally put all the pieces of the puzzle together in the Falcon case and realizes Reggie's new beau Prince Omar is about to become the victim of a dangerous international assassin.

videos.title: I Know Why the Caged Bear Sings
videos.overview: In the heart-stopping season ender, the Bears desperately fight to gain control of an RV with no brakes that's careening down a steep mountain road while trying to reach Prince Omar (Chris Yonan) who whose life is in danger from a deadly assassin hired to stop him from coming out as gay during a worldwide broadcast and streaming event.

videos.title: Where The Bears Are: Season 7
videos.overview: Season 7 will thrust our hairy heroes into yet another thrilling mystery surrounding a bear beauty contest, "Mr. Bear America," that will take place in beautiful Palm Springs, California. Our beloved gang of four decide to go relax for a week in the desert and attend "Bear Week" activities. However, they get more then they bargained for when a vicious and dangerous stalker begins to leave each of them threatening notes! At the same time, Reggie is promoting his latest best-selling book and judging the parade of hairy hunks! Wood too is busy self-promoting, by hosting a pool party at a clothing optional resort to push his latest porn opus, along with his gorgeous, furry models. Nelson is stressed out from shooting the pilot for his new series where his character can "time travel!" And, Todd has a mysterious secret! Something that threatens to break him and Nelson apart forever!
